reflection: Nothing has joined the team. Most factors help in 2023 and 2025 but hurt in 2024, so one-day intraday and relative quantities look like regime-dependent noise. The best signs of life are volume (qqq_volume_surge_peer) and smoothed close location (aapl_close_loc_5d_mean). Both help both models, but they fail in 2022 and 2024. I will try smoothing and normalising these so they are less regime-dependent, and add mean-reversion and volume-price features that are different from the existing ones. I will also try partners built from the peers' volume and trend.

lessons.name: aapl_gap_rolling_mean_5
lessons.lesson: Smoothing the relative gap did not remove its 2024 damage; overnight gaps carry little stable next-day signal.

lessons.name: aapl_close_loc_5d_mean
lessons.lesson: Smoothed close location helped in 2023 and 2025 for both models but its effect flipped in 2022 and 2024, so it is only weakly informative.

lessons.name: peer_dispersion_1d
lessons.lesson: MSFT-NVDA disagreement is new information and helped RF in three years, but it hurt badly in 2024 so its effect is regime-dependent.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_vol_20
lessons.lesson: The relative volatility ratio mostly duplicates AAPL volatility and had no stable directional meaning.

lessons.name: msft_nvda_5d_spread_to_aapl
lessons.lesson: The 5-day lag spread is close to NVDA_cum_return_5d and AAPL_cum_return_5d, so it adds almost nothing and gave RF only a tiny gain.

lessons.name: qqq_volume_surge_peer
lessons.lesson: QQQ volume surge helps both models in stressed 2023 and 2025 but hurt in 2022 and 2024, which suggests it only matters in some regimes.

factors.name: qqq_volume_surge_signed_5d
factors.hypothesis: Volume surge without direction failed in 2022 and 2024 because heavy volume on up days and down days means different things; signing it by QQQ's daily direction separates capitulation from rallies.

factors.name: aapl_close_loc_10d_centered
factors.hypothesis: A longer 10-day window reduces the noise that made the 5-day version flip sign in 2022 and 2024, and centering at 0.5 makes it read as buying or selling pressure.

factors.name: aapl_high_low_reversal_5d
factors.hypothesis: Position inside the 10-day high-low channel captures stretched or oversold states, which differs from the moving-average and return factors and may mean-revert.

factors.name: aapl_volume_price_pressure
factors.hypothesis: Volume on an up or down day signals conviction or exhaustion, and the existing factors do not combine volume with return direction.

factors.name: nvda_volume_surge_lead
factors.hypothesis: Apple's volume surge relative to NVDA's shows whether market-wide activity is Apple-specific, and it complements QQQ's volume surge as a market-condition state.

factors.name: qqq_trend_vs_aapl_trend_20d
factors.hypothesis: Apple's close location shows short-term pressure; the 20-day lag between QQQ and Apple gives the longer-term context that tells whether pressure is likely to continue or revert.
